build_dataset_builder: build a tfds dataset builder for CIFAR-10H with human-annotated soft labels and reaction times
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with image, label, soft_label, human_labels, and annotator features
generate_train_test_splits: generate train and test splits from CIFAR-10 binary files with human annotation data
load_binary_data: load CIFAR-10 binary batch files and yield label-image tuples as numpy arrays
load_human_annotations: load human annotation CSV data and extract per-example fields by example id
